mechanism: Use the existing, all-input-proved R2W01b.convert at once-per-input A mapping and B packet preparation. Preserve native arrays, packet width, lifetime, dot recurrence, output and NaN replay. This removes foreign of_bits calls on zero and raw-exponent 24..254 inputs while retaining ofBits fallback for the remaining words.
source_evidence: Kernel.lean:1901 R2W01c.convert_eq is unconditional; replace_decoder immediately below supports extensional substitution.
Kernel.lean:5115 Packed10.packB still converts each valid B value with ExecFloat.Binary.toFloat32; padding uses zero32 and is not a removable foreign conversion.
Kernel.lean:5583 RowStream.output prepares nativeA with Array.map ExecFloat.Binary.toFloat32 once.
CrossP12.packShared/packGeneral also retain foreign conversions, but are outside the first minimal candidate so the effect is localized.
difference_from_old_results: R4 scalar-decode a7dca manifest explicitly leaves bmm and sum unchanged. Its scalar aggregate regression is not a BMM preparation measurement.
R12 59de/df5c change nativeMul's two operands only. That establishes reusable correctness and a changed scalar call context, not BMM speed.
R11 raw-A removes A preparation and decodes in the MAC loop, causing foreign calls/spills. This proposal retains once-per-input preparation and does not duplicate that mechanism.
R12 GeneralPanel a1ab changes representation/lifetime and failed whole gain; column4 da09 changes width and failed incremental gain. Neither tests this exact decoder substitution.
first_falsifier: Sol's exact-current-source diagnostic: if affected preparation contributes <3% of whole scored time, even eliminating it cannot meet this round's 3% incremental gate. If large enough, actual candidate code generation must show warm conversions lowered without foreign of_bits; compare complete original public-v2 call cost, including converter predicate/table loads/extra multiply and unchanged allocation. Do not allocate cell time by MAC fractions.
mathematical_bridge: Define an inline Binary32-to-Float32 wrapper and unconditional equality via R2W01c.convert_eq. Rewrite only runtime preparation bodies and add local proof rewrites so existing original-value lane/output statements remain unchanged. Full original four-obligation/axiom/checksum gate is still required.
bounded_delivery: One minimal complete candidate, manifest and inverse reconstruction within 45 minutes of selection; first <=15-minute source/exposure/proof feasibility checkpoint. No prediction that CI or independent confirmation fits in those 45 minutes.
opportunity: UNKNOWN until current per-case/stage times. R12 BMM scored share was roughly 16..22% of whole, so a whole 3% gain needs a substantial BMM saving. All-input conversion frequency and warm-path coverage will be reconstructed separately as INFERRED source counts.
fallback_risk: Small normals/subnormals and nonfinite words add a predicate before the original foreign conversion. Allocation remains. A blanket speed claim would be unsupported.
requested_decision: D/Sol assess current preparation time and select this one bounded candidate only if attainable whole gain justifies original full gate; no CI dispatched by R.
history_addendum: R9 direct-decode d5e3512f, run39961709177, full PASS but BMM1.17313/whole1.04035 versus41. Its original548 manifest explicitly leaves the packed pipeline unchanged. This is additional negative context, not a measurement of this once-per-input A/B preparation substitution.
first_falsifier_scope: The stage-share argument is a conditional cost-allocation model assuming other costs unchanged. Observer overhead, changed code generation and cross-stage cache effects can violate that assumption; it is not an unconditional mathematical performance upper bound. Use uninstrumented complete-call data for actual selection.
